An '''unidentified Zabrak''' was a member of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] was one of the many brought forward by [[Viscus/Legends|Brother Viscus]] to appear in front of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] for her selection of capable potential candidates to aid in her plan to get revenge against [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. This Zabrak made it past the initial selection and along with six other Zabraks fought Ventress in her first challenge, the test of arms. He was killed by Ventress when he threw his [[Pike/Legends|pike]] at her only to have her grab it and throw it back at him, killing him.
